subject: Kestrel renewal kickoff — mutual action plan, ops playbook, and QBR slotting
messages:
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Bennett <aisha@kestrel.io>; Tom Hargreaves <thargreaves@kestrel.io>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Kestrel renewal kickoff — mutual action plan, ops playbook, and QBR slotting

Hi Aisha / Tom,

Thanks again for the productive check-in last week. We wanted to kick off the renewal conversation early so we have a clean runway into your 2027 commitments. High-level goals for this thread:

- Capture a short mutual action plan (MAP) for timelines and owners
- Confirm any term/commit changes you’re considering (seat vs throughput model)
- Lock an Exec QBR window (ideally Oct 4–8 or Oct 18–22)
- Share an operations playbook for capacity increases and on-call contacts

I’ve attached a first-pass MAP and a proposed QBR agenda. Can you confirm:
1) Who from Kestrel should be at the Exec QBR (title + name)?
2) Are you evaluating a term extension, seat uplift, or throughput uplift?
3) Any procurement timelines we should be aware of (PO, SOW, legal redlines)?

Next steps from our side: Marissa will map staffing for the uplift window; Ben will prepare pricing scenarios; I’ll coordinate Docs/SOW language with Karthik.

Proposed owners on our side:
- Laura (renewal owner / exec QBR)
- Marissa (onboarding & capacity plan)
- Ben (commercial / pricing)
- Karthik (legal / terms)

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick 30-min call if you prefer to run through the MAP live.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Kestrel_MutualActionPlan_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

Subject: Re: Kestrel renewal kickoff — mutual action plan, ops playbook, and QBR slotting

Hi Laura — thanks for sending these over.

Quick answers:
- Exec QBR attendees: me (Head of Product), Tom Hargreaves (CTO), and Cassie Lee (VP of Ops).
- We’re leaning toward a mixed approach: modest seat uplift for web-facing features + a flexible throughput bucket for batch jobs. We’ll need pricing scenarios for both.
- Procurement: our finance team needs a signed SOW and a PO by mid-November; legal will surface minor security language updates.

Can you kick off a short call this week to walk through the MAP? We’re free Wed 9/23 11:00–11:30am PT or Thu 9/24 2:00–2:30pm PT.

Thanks — happy to see the proposed QBR agenda as well.

Best,
Aisha
Head of Product, Kestrel

Subject: Re: Kestrel renewal kickoff — mutual action plan, ops playbook, and QBR slotting

Laura / team —

Attached is a short commercial note with two scenarios and list pricing. High-level:
- Option A (seat uplift): +30 seats, renew at current term; annualized price +18% reflecting seat mix changes.
- Option B (hybrid): +15 seats + 25% throughput bucket; priced with a throughput discount tier — effective uplift +12% vs current run-rate and includes a 30% burst cap for seasonal jobs.

I also included an SLA uplift add-on (priority scheduling and 99.9% hot-path availability) as an optional line item. I’ll bring the spreadsheet to the QBR.

Attachment: Kestrel_Pricing_Scenarios_v1.xlsx

—Ben
